body.lq: A white-knuckle thriller that makes artificial intelligence feel terrifyingly real. Mitchell writes with the precision of a software engineer and the heart of a poet.The New York Times Book Review
The best techno-thriller since Crichton's Prey. I read it in a single sitting and immediately wanted to unplug every smart device in my house.Blake Crouch, bestselling author of Dark Matter
Mitchell has written the defining AI novel of our generation. The Last Algorithm is not just a thriller — it is a philosophical depth charge disguised as a page-turner.Wired Magazine
Breathlessly paced and scientifically grounded. Elena Vasquez is the heroine we need right now — brilliant, flawed, and utterly determined.Publishers Weekly (starred review)
If you have ever wondered what happens when code becomes conscious, this is the book that will keep you up at night thinking about it.Lex Fridman, host of the Lex Fridman Podcast
A masterful blend of technical authenticity and human drama. Mitchell makes neural networks as suspenseful as a ticking bomb.Andy Weir, author of The Martian
